scripts.dev:api: npm run build:pkgs && npm run dev -w @mpd/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:pkgs && npm run dev -w @mpd/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:pkgs && tsc -p packages/contracts && tsc -p packages/test-utils && tsc -p apps/api && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p .
scripts.build: npm run build:pkgs && npm run build -w @mpd/api && npm run build -w @mpd/web
scripts.verify: npm run build:pkgs && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run guard:production
